entry: Port city on the Aegean coast of [[Anatolia]], capital of İzmir Province. Turkey's third most populous city, after [[Istanbul]] and [[Ankara]], it is the largest metropolitan area on the [[Aegean Sea]] and has a [[Mediterranean climate]]. The city is home to around 3.5 million inhabitants. The site has been settled since the [[Neolithic]] period, and its recorded urban history exceeds 3,000 years. In classical antiquity it was called Smyrna, a name that remained in English until around 1930, when government efforts led to the Turkish form İzmir being adopted internationally. Until the 1923 population exchange it had a very large Greek-speaking population. Today it is an important port and hosts the annual İzmir International Fair.
